additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. A later unrelated FHIR-35853 commit, 680ce0a481a9d96d1981ce1f4ff0b0310f155900, reintroduced the same comment during miscellaneous Observation cleanup while implementing ElementDefinition.type.code binding work. FHIR-22635 confirms Observation.status can be used as an isModifier documentation example, but it does not require duplicating the modifier reason in the Observation.status comment. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that conflicts with the Jira/source-history conclusion.
